subject.title: Feature Request: Per-model turn limits with auto-revert

question: Should OpenClaw add a session-owned multi-turn model lease, and if so should it be unified with the existing one-turn override/API discussion before implementation?
rationale: The source confirms the feature is missing, but choosing persistent versus one-turn versus N-turn semantics changes model routing, session state, config, and Gateway/API contracts.

options.title: Specify a unified lease contract first
options.body: Define one product/API contract that covers one-turn and N-turn overrides, then implement the smallest additive surface with upgrade-safe defaults.

options.title: Keep this issue separate from one-turn overrides
options.body: Allow a narrower `/model --turns` design to proceed independently, accepting the risk of parallel model-routing semantics.

options.title: Defer multi-turn leases
options.body: Close or pause this broader request and keep only the open one-turn and image/fallback auto-revert work active for now.

recommendation.title: Specify a unified lease contract first
recommendation.body: Define one product/API contract that covers one-turn and N-turn overrides, then implement the smallest additive surface with upgrade-safe defaults.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest merged history in the model override/session patch paths that would own the API and compatibility decision.
